subject: Evaluation MAP: environment orchestration — org seed, keys, allowlist & peering runbook
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
To: Jen Park <jen.park@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Evaluation MAP: org seed, API keys, allowlist, peering — suggested kickoff

Jen —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. To keep momentum and get your evaluation onto a production-like path, I drafted a short mutual action plan focused on environment activation items (org setup, API key provisioning, IP allowlist, and VPC peering). The attached PDF is the working draft; I also included a compact preflight checklist (spreadsheet) with clear owners and dates.

High level proposed milestones:
- Week 0 (this week): org seeding and admin role assignment (Aurelia IT)
- Week 1: API key issuance (ephemeral + scoped) and preflight smoke tests
- Week 2: IP allowlist and outbound rule confirmation; begin peering prep
- Week 3: VPC peering test, end-to-end inference trial, SLA/observability handoff

Please confirm: who on your infra side will own the peering request? If acceptable, we can schedule a 45-minute technical handshake on Monday with Neha and Marissa to run through the checklist and capture any constraints.

Attachments: redwood_map_draft_20261211.pdf; map-preflight-checklist-20261211.xlsx

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the peering owner + preferred window for a 45m tech call
2) Aurelia completes the first column of the checklist (owners + dates)
3) We provision a scoped ephemeral API key for evaluation (kept to 7 days by default)

Thanks — looking forward to closing this loop quickly so you can start quantitative testing.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.inference
+1 415-555-0139
From: Jen Park <jen.park@aureliahealth.com>

Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 12:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation MAP: org seed, API keys, allowlist, peering — suggested kickoff

Karthik —

Appreciate the clear plan and the draft MAP. Our infra lead, Marcos Lee (marcos.lee@aureliahealth.com), will own the peering request; I looped in procurement as well (procurement@aureliahealth.com) so they can start on the contract redlines concurrently.

A couple quick clarifications before the tech call:
- API key model: can the scoped key be restricted to a single model and rate-limited? We have conservative egress rules for evaluation tokens.
- VPC peering: do you require a dedicated subnet or can we use an existing shared VPC with a dedicated route table entry?

We can do Monday 2026-12-14 at 14:00 PT for the 45-minute tech handshake. If that works, I’ll ask Marcos to join.

Jen Park
Head of Platform Ops
Aurelia HealthTech
jen.park@aureliahealth.com

Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation MAP: org seed, API keys, allowlist, peering — confirmed call + prechecks

Thanks Jen — and welcome Marcos. Monday 14:00 PT works for our team. I’ve added a short agenda below and included a link to the HubSpot deal so procurement can reference the commercial draft while we talk.

Agenda (45m):
- 5m: Introductions & scope of the evaluation (success metrics)
- 10m: Org seeding, admin role mapping, and API key model (Neha)
- 15m: Networking preflight: IP allowlist, NAT egress, and peering mechanics (Marissa)
- 10m: Timeline to production-like trial & acceptance criteria
- 5m: Action items and owners (capture in the spreadsheet)

Prechecks for your infra team (quick asks to accelerate the call):
1) Confirm a contact for the peering ticket (Jen indicated Marcos) and VPC CIDR(s) to avoid overlap
2) Prepare a list of corporate egress IPs that need to be allowlisted for scoped API access (or confirm if you're using a NAT gateway)
3) If you prefer ephemeral keys vs static keys, note that ephemeral keys will expire after 7 days by default; we can extend to 30 for the trial with a written justification

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/67890
Attachments: map-preflight-checklist-20261211.xlsx

I’ll follow up after the call with the finalized MAP and a short owner-by-owner action list.

Cheers,
Karthik
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Jen Park <jen.park@aureliahealth.com>, Marcos Lee <marcos.lee@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Aurelia HealthTech Procurement <procurement@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation MAP: environment orchestration — org seed, keys, allowlist & peering runbook

All —

Quick note following the tech handshake: great sync today. Per the checklist we agreed on actionable items and owners; I’m pasting the highlights and short fixes here. I also attached our filled security questionnaire where we captured default encryption, logging, and retention controls — please review and return with any Aurelia specifics.

Agreed immediate tasks (owners):
- Aurelia: open peering ticket and share VPC CIDR / shared-VPC details (Marcos) — target 2026-12-16
- Aurelia: supply staging egress IP set for allowlist (Jen / infra) — target 2026-12-15
- Redwood (Neha): provision scoped ephemeral API key limited to model: r-instruct-13b; rate limit 5 rps; TTL = 14 days — target 2026-12-15
- Redwood (Marissa): provide peering template and step-by-step runbook; coordinate routing table entries and test IPs — target 2026-12-17

Notes / clarifications:
- Scoped key: yes — we will bind the evaluation key to a single model and enforce token quotas. We will also enable prefix caching and set a conservative response length cap for trial runs.
- Shared VPC: we can support peering into an existing shared VPC; Marissa will provide the specific peering policy (we recommended a dedicated route table entry to keep test traffic isolated).

Attachments: security-questionnaire-aurelia-20261213.pdf

I’ll update the HubSpot deal with the action items and mark the MAP as 'Technical ready' once we have the peering ticket ID and ephemeral key issued.

-Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.inference
